How to Prepare for an Estate Cleanout

Before hiring help for an estate cleanout, there are a few things you can do to prepare. Here are some tips:

  • Sort through belongings and decide what to keep, donate, or discard
  • Gather important documents and valuables
  • Take photos and videos of the property for insurance purposes
  • Clear a path for the removal team to access the property
  • Be prepared to provide information about the property and the items to be removed
